scope: Proposition 5.2 of the manuscript “Quaternionic division points on curves in the Siegel threefold” (preprints/Quaternionic-Division-Points-on-Curves-in-the-Siegel-Threefold-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 016 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e11b4b068502ced9), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 32. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a fixed odd prime ℓ and a fixed geometrically connected finite étale cover S → S∗ parameterizing symplectic markings at level ℓ, with a fixed lift t0 of t0,∗, such that every quaternionic-division point of S∗ outside a finite set has a lift t ∈ S satisfying the following condition. In the common quadratic space supplied by the markings, dim Lt0 + Lt  = 4, q|Lt0 +Lt is degenerate. (5.1) The prime ℓ is prime to every m ∈ M. At every prime p ̸= ℓ of good reduction for these fixed models where t and t0 have the same marked reduction, the corresponding two saturated Zℓ-lattices have sum M satisfying M = Λℓ ∩ (M ⊗Zℓ Qℓ), rank M = 4, M/ℓM is degenerate. (5.2) These assertions are preserved by simultaneous field conjugation.
